newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-HIH Winterthur in China joint venture.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-HIH Winterthur in China joint venture.

text.p: Insurance group HIH Winterthur International Ltd said on Thursday it would enter the general insurance market in the People's Republic of China through a joint venture with the Northwest group of companies.

HIH Winterthur said it would invest US$16 million in the joint venture vehicle, an approved Sino-foreign joint venture company, which was a shareholder in a new insurance company, the Yong An Property Insurance Company Ltd.

The company said Yong An Insurance, which would have initial registered capital of US$82 million, was backed by key Chinese state-owned industrial groups and would write a variety of property, marine and liability risks.
Management services in underwriting, claims and information would be provided by HIH Winterthur, as would a large reinsurance line on a reinsurance quota share basis, subject to regulatory approval.
HIH Winterthur said it expected the quota share reinsurance scheme to generate a premium stream of at least US$50 million in its first two years.
HIH Winterthur is about 48 percent owned by Winterthur Swiss Insurance Co WINZ.Z.
On September 4, the company reported a 73 percent jump in net profit to A$26.1 million for the first half of 1996 and predicted a stronger result in the second half.
By 3.55 p.m. (0555 GMT), HIH Winterthur shares were four cents lower at A$2.61, after going ex-dividend seven cents, on turnover of 330,600 shares.
